name: Worldforge
summary: Android-first location-based multiplayer fantasy RPG/MMO layered over the real world.
purpose: Turn the player's real-world GPS position into a persistent fantasy MMORPG world with exploration, monsters, quests, settlements, dungeons, loot, progression, and territory systems.
nonGoals: Copying copyrighted characters, locations, terminology, quests, monsters, classes, items, sounds, maps, UI, or other protected content from existing games
architecture: Client and server architecture is still evolving. The design calls for an Android-first client with a persistent server-backed fantasy world mapped from real-world location data.
artDirection: Original fantasy world layered over real geography. Avoid direct visual or terminology copying from existing game IP.
currentState: Core concept and large feature specification exist. Server hosting, multiplayer architecture, moderator tools, approval queues, world mapping, and Android delivery have been actively discussed. Exact latest build state is not documented in Catelog yet.
completed: Moderator promotion and approval-queue concepts defined
decisions: Real-world location maps to fantasy-world position
Owner can approve or deny moderator-submitted content
constraints: Do not silently replace established original-IP requirement
Do not assume a copyrighted game's assets or terminology can be reused
nextTasks: Document the current repository and branch
Record the latest playable build state
Document the canonical client/server data model

history.title: Continued game design
history.description: Expanded the Worldforge project and implementation direction.

history.title: Moderation workflow
history.description: Defined moderator promotion and owner approval queue ideas.

name: RoomForge Gameify
summary: Scan a real room, understand its structure and objects, then rebuild it as a clean game-ready 3D environment.
purpose: Use AR/depth scanning primarily for understanding dimensions, planes, openings, object placement, object scale, orientation, and room connectivity, then replace noisy scan geometry with clean procedural geometry and game assets.
nonGoals: Producing only a noisy photogrammetry mesh
architecture: Pipeline: real house to AR/depth scan to environment understanding to clean geometry to asset replacement to editor to export/explore.
artDirection: User-selectable styles including cartoon, low-poly, PS1, PS2, voxel, realistic, fantasy, and sci-fi.
currentState: Detailed product requirements exist. Work has focused on mapping, object understanding, scan coverage, reconstruction, editing, export, performance, and privacy. Exact latest running build is not documented in Catelog yet.
decisions: Raw scan is for understanding, not final appearance
Detected real objects should map to similar game assets scaled and oriented to match
constraints: Do not treat raw photogrammetry as the finished environment
Preserve measured room dimensions and object transforms
nextTasks: Choose the canonical object-detection model strategy
Record latest scan and reconstruction test results

history.title: Build continuation
history.description: Continued implementation planning for the Android RoomForge/Gameify app.

history.title: Concept expanded
history.description: Expanded the scan-house-to-game-assets concept into a detailed app brief.

name: LyricForge
summary: A polished lyric-video editor focused on music, lyrics, typography, timing, effects, and mobile-friendly editing.
purpose: Let a user upload music, transcribe or supply lyrics, synchronize words and lines, style typography and layers, browse assets/effects, and export lyric videos.
architecture: Browser-based editor with music/lyric state, timing alignment tools, layered visual composition, and export workflow.
artDirection: Simplified professional video editor specialized around music and lyric typography.
currentState: Version 3 source was uploaded to the Astraforge GitHub repository. Mobile portrait improvements and an online asset catalog were requested. The lyric alignment feature was tested and reported to need better accuracy.
knownBugs: Automatic lyric alignment did not work accurately enough in user testing
decisions: Existing lyrics should be alignable by comparing sound cues and expected first/last words around approximate timestamps
Phone portrait layout is a first-class target
constraints: Do not assume current alignment is accurate
nextTasks: Record export limitations and supported formats

history.title: Alignment feedback
history.description: User reported the align-lyrics feature did not work well enough.

history.description: Expanded LyricForge with portrait support and online assets.

name: Bass Transcription App
summary: Android app for extracting bass from songs and turning detected notes into playable fretboard/tab information.
purpose: Separate bass audio, detect notes, map them to fret positions and articulations, and export useful transcription formats.
architecture: Audio separation feeds note detection, then fret mapping and export.
currentState: Detailed technical direction exists, but the current runnable implementation is not documented yet.
decisions: Use Demucs v4 for source separation
Use Basic Pitch TFLite for pitch/note detection

name: AR / 3D Room Scanner Experiments
summary: Android AR experiments for live room meshing, object placement, scan export, and environment capture.
purpose: Explore real-time room scanning and AR placement workflows that can produce reusable 3D scan data.
currentState: Several scanner experiments were attempted. Reports included floor-only detection, crashes, desire for instant 3D output, glass detection, and downloadable scans.
knownBugs: Some prototypes detected only the floor
decisions: Real-time feedback while walking is important
nextTasks: Record supported devices and depth capabilities

name: Rust-like Android Survival Game
summary: Mobile survival sandbox inspired by broad survival-building mechanics, with custom terrain, building, roads, monuments, and voxel-map experiments.
purpose: Build an original mobile survival/building game with touch-first construction, exploration, terrain, monuments, and progression.
nonGoals: Directly copying protected assets or content from Rust
artDirection: Realistic survival environment with an optional voxel map mode.
currentState: Multiple systems and map features were iterated. Recent reports included freezes, broken movement/build/jump, upside-down ground texture, and boulder clipping.
knownBugs: Movement/build/jump broke in at least one iteration
decisions: Voxel map option contains only trees and rocks
constraints: Keep mobile controls large and touch-friendly
